purpose: Teach: 踏み出す/言い換える/照らす/仕え/出くわし/入り込む/病ん/すすん

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが新たな商売に踏み出す決断をされた
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he made the decision to start a new business venture.
lines.style: Soft, searching tone. Gaze turned inward. Pause before speaking, as if retrieving something precious and distant. Quiet reverence for the memory.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、孫に難しい言葉を易しく言い換えるのが上手だったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, dear — your grandfather was so good at explaining difficult things to his grandchildren in simple ways, wasn't he?
lines.style: Warm affirmation with gentle correction underneath. Knowing lilt upward at the end. She's tenderly redirecting him back to his own father's kindness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが提灯で道を照らす役を担われた
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he would light the way for others with his lantern — carry that burden of guidance.
lines.style: Voice pulls inward again. Deliberate, measured pacing. Reverence mixed with melancholy. Like describing something that shaped him profoundly.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、お師匠様に仕える日々を懐かしまれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, dear — you miss those days serving your own master, don't you? That devotion.
lines.style: Perceptive but gentle. A small knowing smile in her voice. She's naming what he hasn't quite said yet, with warmth not sharpness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが旧友に偶然出くわした事もあった
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he would sometimes run into old friends by chance. Those unexpected moments.
lines.style: Voice softens further. Slower pace. A faint smile in the memory. Trailing gently, as if seeing the scene unfold again.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、書物に深く入り込む方でいらしたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, dear — you were always the kind of person to lose yourself in books, weren't you? Deep in your own world.
lines.style: Tender observation without judgment. Rhythm stays gentle and steady. Affirming his solitary nature, not questioning it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが病んでも家族を支えられた
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, even when he fell ill, he found the strength to hold his family up.
lines.style: Voice drops lower, deeper respect woven through. A quiet ache underneath the admiration. Slow, deliberate delivery honoring that sacrifice.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、ご家族のために前にすすんでこられたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, dear — you've always moved forward for your family, haven't you? That's who you are.
lines.style: Final affirmation, quiet and certain. Warmth mixed with knowing sadness. She's not asking; she's confirming what she's always seen in him. Soft close.
